oracle: Concurrent verification requests reserve one live code and mail it once (SPEC §14)
what: Use the gate-held stale preliminary verification snapshot instead of reading the authoritative record inside the transaction, reproducing competing resend reservations.

target.case: C19b S23 (SYNC-P): the code requests held after every one has read the verification in progress and before any stores a code, then let go one at a time; one code is mailed and the rest are refused 429 by the resend gap, and the code mailed verifies the account (SPEC §14) [N=2]
